title: Baidu CFO Henry He says the company plans to spin off and list its chip unit Kunlunxin in Hong Kong and Shanghai in 2026, making it more like a "neutral player" (Tracy Qu/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Tracy Qu / Wall Street Journal: Baidu CFO Henry He says the company plans to spin off and list its chip unit Kunlunxin in Hong Kong and Shanghai in 2026, making it more like a “neutral player” — Plans to spin off and list Kunlunxin Technology in Hong Kong and Shanghai are on track
